introZh: 请先在作答框中写出译文，再点「核对」比对答案；也可直接「显示答案」。

part1.titleZh: 练习一 · 译成中文（或你使用的语言）
part1.hintZh: 昆雅 → 目标语；对照词汇表与正文例句。

items.prompt: Utúlientë cenien me, lá cenien tye.
items.answerKey: They have come to see us, not to see thee.
items.answerZh: keys：They have come to see us, not to see thee.

items.answerKey: May you dream about Elves! (Wish that you will dream about Elves!)
items.answerZh: keys：May you dream about Elves! (Wish that you will dream about Elves!)

items.prompt: Neldë neri lelyuvar tanna, ar i Naucor tiruvar te, an i neri haryar harma i ná alta lá malta.
items.answerKey: Three men will go thither, and the Dwarves will watch them, for the men possess a treasure that is greater than [lit. "great beyond"] gold.
items.answerZh: keys：Three men will go thither, and the Dwarves will watch them, for the men possess a treasure that is greater than [lit. "great beyond"] gold.

items.prompt: I enquëa auressë ornë tien tulë ninna.
items.answerKey: On the sixth day they felt moved to come to me. [Lit. "...(it) impelled for them to come to me."]
items.answerZh: keys：On the sixth day they felt moved to come to me. [Lit. "...(it) impelled for them to come to me."]

items.prompt: I enquëa aran i nórëo ná saila lá atarerya i lempëa aran.
items.answerKey: The sixth king of the land is wiser than ["wise beyond"] his father the fifth king.
items.answerZh: keys：The sixth king of the land is wiser than ["wise beyond"] his father the fifth king.

items.prompt: Palunes coarya, cárala ta i analta coa i mallëo.
items.answerKey: (S)he expanded his/her house, making it [or, that] the biggest house of the street.
items.answerZh: keys：(S)he expanded his/her house, making it [or, that] the biggest house of the street.

items.answerKey: You did it for them; you did not do it for us. (Alternatively, "you made it for them; you did not make it for us": Car- covers both "do" and "make".)
items.answerZh: keys：You did it for them; you did not do it for us. (Alternatively, "you made it for them; you did not make it for us": Car- covers both "do" and "make".)

items.prompt: Cennelmë le i cilyassë nu me, an lantanelyë mir ta.
items.answerKey: We saw you in the gorge under us, for you fell into it.
items.answerZh: keys：We saw you in the gorge under us, for you fell into it.

part2.hintZh: 目标语 → 昆雅；注意复数、冠词 i、词序。

items.prompt: My right arm is stronger than my left arm.
items.answerKey: Forya rancunya ná polda lá hyarya rancunya.
items.answerZh: keys：Forya rancunya ná polda lá hyarya rancunya.

items.prompt: The bogies are watching me, for I fear them [Quenya: "fear from them", ablative].
items.answerKey: I urqui tírar nye, an rucin(yë) tiello.
items.answerZh: keys：I urqui tírar nye, an rucin(yë) tiello.

items.prompt: We [exclusive] will not come to see thee in the night.
items.answerKey: Lá tuluvalmë cenien tye i lómissë.
items.answerZh: keys：Lá tuluvalmë cenien tye i lómissë.

items.prompt: The boy will not dream about [genitive] bogies.
The two women said: "Your king did not want to give us [dual dative] the things taken [or, "seized" – mapainë, pl.] from us [dual ablative] by his warriors."
items.answerKey: I atta nissi quenter: "Aranelya lá mernë anta ment i engwi mapainë melto ohtariryainen."
items.answerZh: keys：I atta nissi quenter: "Aranelya lá mernë anta ment i engwi mapainë melto ohtariryainen."

items.prompt: The man expanding his house is doing that [or, it] (in order) to make many rooms for [dative] all his things.
items.answerKey: I nér pálula coarya cára ta carien rimbë sambi ilyë engweryain.
items.answerZh: keys：I nér pálula coarya cára ta carien rimbë sambi ilyë engweryain.

items.prompt: The sixth day will be [nauva] better than the fifth day, and we [exclusive] will not feel moved to leave [auta]. ["Better than" = "good beyond"!]
items.answerKey: I enquëa aurë nauva mára lá i lempëa aurë, ar lá oruva men auta. Other word-orders would apparently also be possible, such as prefixing some independent pronouns to verbs: K) nye-tírar rather than tírar nye, L) tye-cenien rather than cenien tye, N) ment-anta rather than anta ment, O) ta-cára rather than cára ta, P) men-oruva rather than oruva men.
items.answerZh: keys：I enquëa aurë nauva mára lá i lempëa aurë, ar lá oruva men auta. Other word-orders would apparently also be possible, such as prefixing some independent pronouns to verbs: K) nye-tírar rather than tírar nye, L) tye-cenien rather than cenien tye, N) ment-anta rather than anta ment, O) ta-cára rather than cára ta, P) men-oruva rather than oruva men.
